description: Unit tests for GStreamer EME (Encrypted Media Extensions) utilities, including processing of protection metadata, handling of different encryption schemes, and subsample processing.

classes.name: GStreamerEmeUtilsTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for GStreamer EME utility tests, holding a BufferProtectionMetadata instance.

methods.name: ShouldNotProcessNullBuffer
methods.description: Test that processing a null buffer does not cause errors.

methods.name: ShouldProcessSubsamples
methods.description: Test processing of subsample data with clear and encrypted byte counts.

methods.name: ShouldProcessCbcsEncryptionScheme
methods.description: Test processing of 'cbcs' encryption scheme, expecting CBCS cipher mode.

methods.name: ShouldProcessCencEncryptionScheme
methods.description: Test processing of 'cenc' encryption scheme, expecting CENC cipher mode.

methods.name: ShouldProcessCbc1EncryptionScheme
methods.description: Test processing of 'cbc1' encryption scheme, expecting CBC1 cipher mode.

methods.name: ShouldProcessCensEncryptionScheme
methods.description: Test processing of 'cens' encryption scheme, expecting CENS cipher mode.

methods.name: ShouldProcessUnknownEncryptionScheme
methods.description: Test processing of an unknown encryption scheme, expecting UNKNOWN cipher mode.

methods.name: ShouldFailToReadEncryptionPatternWhenSkipByteBlockIsNotFound
methods.description: Test that encryption pattern processing fails when 'crypt_byte_block' is missing.
